outcome: Laboratory findings (C-reactive protein, procalcitonin, time-to-positivity of culture)
cohort: A total of 11 neonates diagnosed with listeriosis at Maternal and Child Health Hospital of Hubei Province, China, between January 2015 and December 2022.
finding: Neonatal listeriosis is a rare but severe infection with a 27% mortality rate, commonly presenting with respiratory distress, elevated C-reactive protein (CRP) and procalcitonin (PCT), and Apgar score at 5 minutes and CRP are relevant prognostic indices.
